page: The Microsoft Azure D4ps_v5 is a general-purpose virtual machine based on the arm64 architecture, hosted on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features an Ampere ARMv8 Neoverse-N1 processor operating at a sustained clock speed of 3.0 GHz across 4 physical cores and 4 dedicated vCPUs with a single thread per core. Memory capacity is configured at 16.0 GB, yielding a standard 1:4 core-to-RAM allocation of 4.0 GB per core. The CPU cache architecture comprises 64 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB of L2 cache per core, and a shared 32 MB L3 cache. It includes hardware AES cryptographic support but does not provide local disk storage or GPU acceleration.

In benchmark assessments, the D4ps_v5 demonstrates average multi-core and single-core compute performance within its resource tier, registering a stress-ng multi-core score of 7,240.75 and a single-core score of 1,821.99. Memory bandwidth tests show 50.19 GB/sec for large-block uncached reads and 29.49 GB/sec for writes. Conversely, general processing benchmarks like Geekbench reflect lower-tier performance with a single-core rating of 1,110.0 and a multi-core score of 3,595.0. Workload-specific throughput reached 5.58 GB/sec for static web delivery and 5.45 million operations per second in Redis SET evaluations, alongside moderate database operation scores.

The ARM-based architecture provides resource efficiency for predictable scaling, offering dedicated non-hyperthreaded cores that limit noisy-neighbor interference. Because local ephemeral disks are absent, persistent storage requires remote network-attached disks, which impacts disk-intensive operations. The instance is suited for ARM-native software stacks, web serving, microservice hosting, CI/CD runners, and distributed application tiers that do not rely on x86 vector extensions.
description: The Microsoft Azure D4ps_v5 is a general-purpose virtual machine built on the 64-bit ARM architecture. Powered by a 4-core Ampere ARMv8 Neoverse-N1 processor running at 3.0 GHz, it supplies 4 dedicated vCPUs without simultaneous multithreading and includes 16.0 GB of memory at a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. Cache resources include 64 KB L1d, 1.0 MB L2, and 32 MB shared L3. It lacks onboard local storage and GPU accelerators, using attached storage solutions for persistent disk operations. Benchmark results place its multi-core stress-ng performance (7,240.75) and uncached memory bandwidth (50.19 GB/sec read, 29.49 GB/sec write) in the middle tier, while Geekbench and cryptographic test results rank lower against broader cloud hardware baselines. The D4ps_v5 is suited for containerized services, web serving, standard business logic, and ARM-native software development pipelines.
